as_told.title: MJ-12 renamed the UFO Working Group in 1986

plain: In 1986 a group called the UFO Working Group was formed, with backing from an Army general named Albert Stubblebine, according to the Army officer Philip J. Corso. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb tells Michels this, reading from a text called Dawn of a New Age and from a manuscript by Corso. In his second pass he goes further: it 'kind of seems', he says, that around 1986 Majestic 12, a secret panel of officials that some papers say managed the UFO question, took the new name UFO Working Group and brought in new people such as Stubblebine and staff from the National Security Agency, which would mean the secret panel lasted for decades under a new name.
